exposure: Treatment group (B ultrasound-guided gestational MTX inject group, local intramuscular treatment group, uterine artery perfusion MTX group)
Injection MTX treatment for Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
outcome: Time to normalization of blood chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG) and progesterone
cohort: 34 patients diagnosed with CSP between 2000 and 2013
finding: B ultrasound-guided gestational injection of MTX and uterine artery embolization perfusion MTX are better treatment options for uterine scar pregnancy compared to local intramuscular treatment.
